gyms.name: Listfield Gym
gyms.introText: Prof. Shell adjusts her glasses. 'Every journey through the terminal begins with knowing where you are. Show me you can list, read, and echo before I let you pass!'
gyms.winText: Prof. Shell smiles. 'You found what you were looking for. The List Badge is yours. Remember — ls -la shows you everything, even what hides in the shadows.'

gyms.name: Filebrook Gym
gyms.introText: Fiona slams a folder shut. 'A sloppy filesystem is a sloppy mind! Move things, copy things, delete things — show me you CONTROL your files!'
gyms.winText: Fiona tosses you the File Badge. 'Good. Your workspace is your weapon. Keep it clean, keep it organized. And never rm -rf / by accident.'

gyms.name: Pattern Gorge Gym
gyms.introText: Greg peers at you over a magnifying glass. 'Data is everywhere. The question is whether you can FIND it. grep your way through my team!'
gyms.winText: Greg lowers the magnifying glass. 'Pattern matched. You have the Grep Badge. Regex is the language of the gods — learn it well.'

gyms.name: Process Peak Gym
gyms.introText: Petra stares at a terminal screen scrolling with process IDs. 'My Bashmons haunt the process table. Can you hunt them down? Show me your kill command!'
gyms.winText: Petra nods slowly. 'Process terminated. The Process Badge is yours. Always check ps aux before you rm — you might kill more than you intend.'

gyms.name: Netfall City Gym
gyms.introText: Nick stands at a blinking router terminal. 'The network connects everything — and my Bashmons swim through it like sharks. Ping me if you dare!'
gyms.winText: Nick unplugs a cable and hands you the Network Badge. 'Connection established. Always encrypt your ssh, never curl into a pipe without checking.'

gyms.name: Sudo Summit Gym
gyms.introText: Sam sits on an elevated platform, all screens showing root terminals. 'You've come far, trainer. But do you understand POWER? Real power requires permission. Take it!'
gyms.winText: Sam descends from the platform. 'Root access granted. The Sudo Badge is yours. With great power comes great responsibility — sudo responsibly.'

gyms.name: Pipe Plains Gym
gyms.introText: Paige stands in a maze of literal pipes. 'One command alone is weak. Chain them together and you become unstoppable. Show me your pipes!'
gyms.winText: Paige emerges from a tunnel. 'Beautiful piping. The Pipe Badge is yours. Remember — the pipe is the most powerful operator in the terminal.'

gyms.name: Versionpeak Gym
gyms.introText: Victor stands before a wall of terminals. 'You've mastered individual commands. But can you wield them all together? The terminal is your canvas. Paint!'
gyms.winText: Victor's screens go dark one by one. 'You ARE the terminal now. The Terminal Badge is yours. The Bashmon League awaits.'
